name: tm6ynf-platform-adapters
goal: Prove a Harness host can bind a Slack bot to an approved workspace and channels, send, receive and reply without exposing credentials, and record mocked and live verification separately.

evidence: Spec defines the adapter contract, Slack/Vault boundaries, runtime placement and verification gates. Documentation links and scoped formatting pass.

Implemented the Slack transport, trusted host/Vault interface, adapter registry, installation-bound MCP surface and owner-only audit journal. Live Vault binding and host activation remain pending under verification.
13 focused cases passed across mocked Slack Web API and Socket Mode, real loopback WebSocket transport, registry, MCP protocol and audit journal tests.
